delta_from_prior: Replaces the disjoint twin-pair gadgets of Neon58 and Neon78 (neon_worstcase_auto_00078, 24 vars, 156 clauses, max width 8) with an asymmetric bipartite overlapping-path transversal (P_4 + P_4 + P_4) x (P_4 + P_4) lifted on four Side-B endpoints (24 vars, 142 clauses, max width 6). Every component has zero link-twin pairs (defeating Fable73's proposed nonlinear OR-twin contraction), compresses cleanly to a 20-variable 90-clause kernel-free quotient, defeats composed core_refutation on both stages, hides the 27 width-6 Side-A cover clauses from IALH-5 at shallow depths, and reaches at least 8 pairwise incomparable states by layer 3 without relying on any compression skip.
explanation:
### 1. Code Audit of Pinned v5
Auditing `blq-composed-core-scc-emra-ialh5-v5`, `compression.py`, `core_refutation.py`, and the pinned `canon_plus`/`elim_plus`/`prune`/`two_sat` dependencies finds no soundness bug:
- `compression._verify_certificate` partitions `dense_formula(formula, ids)` into blocks covering every original clause, checks that every quotient coordinate used in a block is supported within that block's mask, exhaustively checks `evaluate(clauses, x) == evaluate(q, image)` on all `2**|support|` local assignments, and verifies `parity(forms[i] & columns[j]) == int(i == j)` for all `i, j`, proving `P * L = I_r` over GF(2) and hence surjectivity and equisatisfiability.
- `core_refutation.probe` independently enforces `set(core).issubset(set(f))`, requires `compress_root(core)` to succeed with a binary quotient, and only returns `UNSAT` when `two_sat(q)` is false. Composing it once on an accepted quotient preserves soundness by exact equivalence.
- `refute` checks every local lattice consequence on UP tables and validates the global dual via `fractions.Fraction` in `verify_dual`.
- Priority correction acknowledged: Neon54/55 near-parity instances peak at 0 because width-5 UP tables retain the global XOR congruence even after deleting a satisfying point. Any valid growth target must therefore be genuinely nonlinear and kernel-free.

### 2. Construction: Non-Twin Overlapping-Path Transversal `(P_4 + P_4 + P_4) x (P_4 + P_4)`
To attack both v5 and Fable73's proposed nonlinear link-twin (OR-pair) contraction, we replace disjoint twin pairs with disjoint 4-vertex paths `P_4` (`u0 - u1 - u2 - u3`), whose 3 edges `{u0,u1}, {u1,u2}, {u2,u3}` overlap and whose 3 minimal vertex covers are `{u0,u2}, {u1,u2}, {u1,u3}`:
- **No twin pairs:** Every vertex in `P_4` has a distinct edge/cover neighborhood; no pair of variables factors through an OR-gate `x v y`.
- **Side A (`A1, A2, A3`, 12 plain vars):**
  - `A1: 7 - 1 - 4 - 8`, `A2: 9 - 2 - 5 - 10`, `A3: 11 - 3 - 6 - 12`.
  - 9 edges total; `3^3 = 27` negative width-6 clauses forbidding all vertex covers of `A1 + A2 + A3` (forcing at least one edge of Side A to be `00`).
- **Side B (`B1, B2`, 4 plain + 4 XOR-lifted endpoints = 12 original vars):**
  - `B1: b0 - 13 - 14 - b3`, `B2: b4 - 15 - 16 - b7`, where `b0 = 17^18`, `b3 = 19^20`, `b4 = 21^22`, `b7 = 23^24`.
  - 6 edges total; `3^2 = 9` quotient negative width-4 clauses lift to `5 * 5 = 25` original clauses (widths 4–6), forcing at least one edge of Side B to be `00`.
- **Cross clauses:** All `9 * 6 = 54` quotient positive width-4 clauses `e_A U e_B` forbid an all-zero edge on Side A simultaneously with one on Side B; lifting the 4 Side-B endpoints expands these to `18 + 36*2 = 90` original clauses (widths 4–5).
- **Totals:** 24 variables (`1..24`), `27 + 25 + 90 = 142` clauses, max width 6, UNSAT. Nearby SAT control: deleting any single cross-clause `e_A U e_B` makes the formula SAT by setting `e_A = 00`, `e_B = 00`, and all remaining vertices to `1`.

### 3. Exact Trace on v5 (Compression, Core, IALH-5, Residual Growth)
- **Root compression (`compress_root`):** All 90 quotient clauses have distinct supports, giving 90 blocks with max width 6 and `space = 3568 <= 16384`. Each lifted block's stabilizer is exact (`span` of the active `e_{2k-1}^e_{2k}` vectors). Block frequencies of the 20 true basis forms are:
  - `1..6` (Side-A interiors): 30 (popcount 1) -> `q1..q6`
  - `13..16` (Side-B interiors): 24 (popcount 1) -> `q7..q10`
  - `7..12` (Side-A endpoints): 15 (popcount 1) -> `q11..q16`
  - `e17^e18, e19^e20, e21^e22, e23^e24` (Side-B endpoints): 12 (popcount 2) -> `q17..q20`
  Every non-basis sum either has frequency `< 12` or lies in the span of already-selected higher-frequency singletons. Thus compression succeeds cleanly (no skip) and maps to the exact 20-variable, 90-clause quotient in ascending order `q1..q20`.
- **Core refutation (`core_refutation.probe`):** Every block of the original 142-clause input is already a complete coset of its stabilizer, and every block of the 90-clause quotient has size 1. In both stages, no XOR-difference has partial count, so `core == f` and both probes return `UNKNOWN (no_clauses_removed)`.
- **Root residual (`canon_plus`, `elim_plus`, `ialh5`):** No binary/unit clauses exist. Every variable has `pos >= 6` and `neg >= 3` with non-tautological resolvent blowup, so `elim_plus` is stuck. All 27 Side-A negative clauses have width 6 (`> k=5`), invisible to `windows`; every width `<= 5` window has UP table spanning `Z^|W|`, yielding 0 hull rows.
- **Branching growth:** `run_counting_core` branches first on `q1=1 (a1), q2=2 (a5), q3=3 (a9)`, one interior vertex from each Side-A `P_4`. In each `A_i`:
  - `0` eliminates the far endpoint by pure literal, leaving 2 positive width-3 templates and 1 negative width-2 cover;
  - `1` eliminates the near endpoint, leaving 1 positive width-4 template and 2 negative width-1 covers.
  Across `(q1, q2, q3) in {0,1}^3`, all 8 states at layer 3 remain stuck and pairwise incomparable under `below`: `000` (5 `A`-vars, width-7 mixed clauses), `001/010/100` (distinct 4-var subsets, width-6 mixed clauses), `011/101/110` (distinct 2-var positive-3-clause subsets plus pure-negative 4-clauses), and `111` (6 `A`-vars, pure-negative 3-clauses, no positive 3-clauses). None is refuted by `ialh5` (all width `<= 5` windows remain full-rank integer hulls), guaranteeing observed `peak >= 8` (and ~11 at layer 4 before `elim_plus` collapses all-zero-edge branches on Side B). This is a finite growth fixture, not an asymptotic lower bound.
